verdict.rationale: Ledgy is an equity-management SaaS, and a built-in AI assistant is a plausible feature for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an in-product AI assistant or any way to delegate tasks to one. The automation evidence covers bulk granting, signature workflows and one-click reports, which are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
